cards.text: Elisha, the prophet known as the man of God, once brought a woman's son back to life (2 Kings 4:32-37). Earlier, he had told her the LORD decreed a seven-year famine was coming to the land. And he had some instructions for her.

cards.question: With a seven-year famine coming, what does Elisha tell the woman and her household to do?

answers.text: Leave and live as foreigners wherever they can
Stay home and store up all the grain they can
Move inside the walls of Samaria and wait it out

cards.text: She does just as the man of God told her, and her household goes with her. You know when the alarm says GET UP and people hit snooze THREE times? Not her.

cards.question: The woman and her household live as foreigners for seven years in the land of the Philistines.

answers.text: True
False

cards.text: Seven years go by. Then the woman comes back from the land of the Philistines, ready to appeal for her house and her land.

cards.question: With her house and her land to appeal for, the woman goes to the ___.

answers.text: king
elders
priest

cards.text: Now the king has been talking with Gehazi, the servant of the man of God. And the king has a request.

cards.question: What does the king ask Gehazi, Elisha's servant, to tell him?

answers.text: All the great things Elisha has done
Where Elisha has been staying lately
Why the famine lasted so many years

cards.question: Gehazi is telling the king how Elisha brought the dead back to life. Who comes in at that very moment?

answers.text: The woman whose son Elisha revived
Elisha the man of God himself
A messenger from Ben-hadad of Aram

cards.text: Gehazi is right in the middle of that story, and in she walks. Friend, I've stamped cookies for YEARS and I still can't get my cookies and my timer to finish at the same time.

cards.question: Gehazi is telling the king how Elisha brought the dead back to life, and the woman walks in. What does Gehazi say to the king?

answers.text: This is the woman and her son Elisha revived
This woman should come back another day
This woman must speak with Elisha first

cards.question: Gehazi tells the king this is the woman and the son Elisha restored to life. When the king asks her about it, she says Gehazi has it mixed up.

answers.text: True
False

cards.text: She confirms it, so the king has heard it from Gehazi AND from the woman herself. Then the king appoints an officer for her.

cards.question: The king tells the officer to restore all that was hers, along with everything her ___ produced.

answers.text: field
flocks
servants

cards.question: The king's order covers what the woman's field produced only since the day she came back to appeal.

answers.text: True
False
